3DU1.reason: LaunchBox: 3-D Ultra Pinball (1995), not its 1997 sequel The Lost Continent. Page: The blog titles 3D Ultra Pinball by its Space Colony table.

AYA.reason: The same 1994 game; the installer drops its subtitle.

C2K.reason: C.I.T.Y. 2000 London is the 1993 game's London edition.

CJU.reason: The installer titles CyberJudas (1996) as Shadow President 2.

DAAC.reason: Disney's Aladdin Activity Center is an educational activity program; eXoDOS's Disney's Aladdin is Virgin's 1994 platformer. LaunchBox: Aladdin Activity Center.

DASH.reason: Page: The blog's Disney's Animated Storybook: Hercules.

DASS.reason: Page: The blog's Disney's Ariel's Story Studio.

DASW.reason: LaunchBox: Disney's Animated Storybook: Winnie the Pooh and the Honey Tree, the 1995 storybook.

DBOG.reason: The installer names Disney's Beauty and the Beast: Be Our Guest by its subtitle.

DHC.reason: Preview: the post's gallery mixes every machine's releases; this is Die Hard on DOS.

DTPJ.reason: Page: The blog's Disney's The Lion King: Timon & Pumbaa's Jungle Games.

DTTG.reason: LaunchBox: Disney's The Hunchback of Notre Dame: Topsy Turvy Games. Page: The blog's Disney's The Hunchback of Notre Dame: Topsy Turvy Games.

EXA.reason: Version: its "Extreme Assault" shortcut starts the software version (dosbox-x.conf); 3DFX.conf, which sorts first, needs DOSBox-X's Glide passthrough, which Staging does not have.

FAT.reason: Fatal Racing is the European title of Gremlin's Whiplash. Version: its "Fatal Racing" shortcut starts dosbox_FAT.conf; dosbox_3DFX.conf, which sorts first, is its "Fatal Racing 3Dfx" shortcut's.

FEM.reason: Frankenstein: Through the Eyes of the Monster is a 1995 adventure; eXoDOS's Frankenstein is a 1994 platform game. LaunchBox: Frankenstein: Through the Eyes of the Monster.

FFC.reason: Page: The blog's Fantastic 4: Interactive CD-ROM.

FT2.reason: LaunchBox: Full Tilt! 2 Pinball, not the first Full Tilt! Pinball. Page: The blog's Full Tilt! 2 Pinball, not the first game's page.

GML.reason: LaunchBox: Great Myths & Legends Volume 1: Monsters & Mythical Creatures, the volume the installer's notes describe.

GRMC.reason: Preview: the post's gallery mixes every machine's releases; this is Gremlins 2 on DOS.

HGC.reason: Page: The blog's Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy Collection. Preview: the installer runs the text adventure under Frotz and a Windows remake; this is the DOS Trivia Challenge.

IJAC.reason: Preview: the post's gallery mixes every machine's releases; this is Fate of Atlantis: The Action Game on DOS.

IMC.reason: LaunchBox has no Iron Man Interactive CD-ROM Comic Book; its title is close to the Spider-Man one's.

JDB.reason: LaunchBox: Jump: The David Bowie Interactive CD-ROM. Page: The blog's Jump: The David Bowie Interactive CD-ROM.

JP1.reason: Ocean's 1993 Jurassic Park; the installer calls it Volume 1.

KB0.reason: King's Bounty Classic is New World Computing's 1990 King's Bounty.

LGP.reason: The installer is Leather Goddesses of Phobos 2 with the first game added (2+).

NR2.reason: Version: its "NASCAR Racing 2 (Direct 3D)" shortcut's dosbox-D3D.conf (N2.BAT, on the emulated Voodoo); dosbox.conf, which sorts first, is its "(3Dfx)" shortcut's N23DFX.BAT, for DOSBox Glide passthrough, which Staging does not have ("Cannot determine glide port").

PYL.reason: Version: its "PYL - SOFTWARE" shortcut's dosboxSFT.conf; cheats.conf, which sorts first, is its cheat launcher's, and the two Glide shortcuts' need DOSBox Glide passthrough, which Staging does not have ("unable to load DLL").

QG2.reason: LaunchBox: The Vortex: Quantum Gate II.

RML.reason: The installer drops the Ripley's Believe It or Not! of the title.

RVL.reason: LaunchBox: Rolling Stones Voodoo Lounge CD-ROM. Page: The blog's Rolling Stones: Voodoo Lounge CD-ROM.

RVT.reason: Page: The blog's RoboCop vs The Terminator.

SCR.reason: Version: its "Screamer Rally" shortcut starts dosbox_SCR.conf; dosbox_3DFX.conf, which sorts first, is its "Screamer Rally 3Dfx" shortcut's, for DOSBox Glide passthrough.

SM6.reason: LaunchBox: Marvel Comics Spider-Man: The Sinister Six, not the Interactive CD-ROM Comic Book.

STHA.reason: DS9 abbreviates Deep Space Nine; the same 1996 game.

TC1.reason: Version: The Terminator (T1.conf), the collection's first game; Setup-T2.conf, which sorts first, is The Terminator 2029's install utility.

TT3.reason: The installer drops The Adventures of of the title.

TTX.reason: Page: The blog's Terror T.R.A.X.: Track of the Vampire.
